purpose: Internal SECURITY DEFINER helper for atomic canonical Activity creation; direct runtime EXECUTE retired in B05-B so public creation always assigns one Life Area in the same transaction.

routine.return_type: TABLE(activity_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.current_binding: The capability returns canonical Activity creation state or an idempotent replay; it does not create or select a Domain MaterialState.
state_history.chronology: A single statement_timestamp value is used for the descriptor and receipt created in one authoritative transaction.
state_history.immutability_policy: Existing operation receipts are replay-only. A fingerprint mismatch is rejected and cannot mutate the prior accepted operation.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: The routine is removed only by the introducing migration downgrade, and that downgrade fails closed while canonical Activity intention rows exist.

obligations: function owner is dante_owner and SECURITY DEFINER is enabled
B05-B denies direct runtime EXECUTE while its Life Area-bound wrapper remains executable
runtime receives no generic INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE authority on Activity persistence
UUIDv7 Activity identity, NativeAddress, descriptor and receipt are created atomically
same operation id/same intent replays and same operation id/different intent conflicts
